title: Folding Language Models into Themselves
abstract: arXiv:2611.18113v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge distillation usually trains a compact student from scratch, which needs a large amount of data even though the teacher's weights already encode most of what the student has to learn. In this work, we explore building the student directly from the teacher's weights. We propose Concertina, which folds every group of N adjacent teacher layers into one shared block that is executed N times. Each loop step carries a low-rank correction initialized from the layer it replaces, and a per-token gate mixes these corrections, to let every token recover the behavior of the original layers from a single shared block. We further design a distillation data recipe that balances general, mathematical, academic and targeted multiple-choice data, to recover all capabilities of the teacher together rather than one at the expense of another. On Qwen3-4B, a 2.27B Concertina model distilled on 22B tokens retains about 90% of the teacher on commonsens

translated_title: 将语言模型折叠进自身
translated_abstract: 知识蒸馏通常从头训练一个紧凑的学生模型，即使教师的权重已经编码了学生所需学习的大部分内容，这仍然需要大量数据。在这项工作中，我们探索直接从教师的权重构建学生模型。我们提出了Concertina，它将每组N个相邻的教师层折叠为一个共享块，该共享块执行N次。每个循环步骤携带一个从其替换层初始化的低秩修正，并通过一个逐token的门控机制混合这些修正，使每个token能够从单个共享块中恢复原始各层的行为。我们进一步设计了一套蒸馏数据配方，平衡通用、数学、学术和针对性的多选题数据，以同时恢复教师的各项能力，而不是以牺牲某一能力为代价换取另一能力。在Qwen3-4B上，一个在22B token上蒸馏的2.27B Concertina模型在常识任务上保留了教师约90%的性能。
tldr: 提出Concertina方法，将N个相邻教师层折叠为执行N次的共享块并配合低秩修正和逐token门控，直接从教师权重构建紧凑学生模型，在22B token训练量下保留教师约90%的性能。
en_tdlr: Concertina folds N adjacent teacher layers into a single shared block executed N times with low-rank corrections and per-token gating, building a compact student directly from teacher weights and retaining about 90% of teacher performance on 22B tokens.
